Name: Audio Descriptions
Author: mistyspring
Description:
[size=3]Hi, this is a mod i made for accessibility purposes.

Since SDV uses audio as context cues, i'm not sure how deaf/HoH people get around it. This mod aims to help!

Here's some things you can enable:
[/size][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]Fishing noises:[/b] When a fish bites bait, when it escapes, etc.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]NPC noises:[/b] Enemies roaring/screeching (when they spawn), farm animals, etc.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Environment noises:[/b] Thunder, bushes rustling, owl/bird noises.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
There's also options like:

[/size][list]
[*][size=3][b]Player noises:[/b] Eating, drinking, jumping through a hole etc.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]Item sounds:[/b] Watering can, chest/door creaking, parrying, etc.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
(All configurable)

If you have any suggestions for this mod, please let me know.
[/size]

Manifest.Name: Audio descriptions
Manifest.Description: Displays current sound and a description.
